place.en: Black Pine Ridge · the broken stele

setup.zh: 岭口的断碑只剩「勿入」两字。爹说：你在这儿等我。
setup.en: Only two characters are left on the broken stele at the ridge mouth: Do not enter. Father says: wait for me here.

recap.zh: 断碑前，你和爹定了三条规矩，跨进了黑松岭。
recap.en: At the broken stele you and Father made three rules, and stepped into Black Pine Ridge.

zh: 岭口一块断碑，半截埋在土里。
碑后松林，一点风都没有。
en: A broken stele at the ridge mouth, half buried.
Two characters left: Do not enter.
Behind it the pines, not a breath of wind.

text.zh: 两个字刻得极深，笔画里积满了黑泥，倒像刻字的人生怕后人看不清。
text.en: The two characters are cut very deep, their strokes packed with black mud, as if whoever carved them feared no one after would read them.

text.zh: 你捡了块石子扔进松林，石子落了地，竟没有一点声响。
text.en: You toss a pebble into the pines. It lands — and makes no sound at all.

label.en: The dead grass at its foot

text.zh: 碑脚下的枯草有半人高，一根根朝外倒着，倒像许多年前有人扒开过，又慢慢长拢了。
text.en: The dead grass at the stele's foot stands half a man high and leans outward, as if someone parted it long ago and it slowly grew back.

story.zh:
石坳村的孩子，还不会走路，就听过黑松岭的故事。

岭口立着一块断碑，半截埋在土里。碑上的字，风吹雨打了不知道多少年，早就认不全了。只剩下最后两个，还看得清清楚楚——

**勿入。**

村里的老人说，那块碑，比村子还老，比马家还老，比县城的城墙都老。

村里的老人说，过了断碑，林子就不一样了。树会自己挪地方，路会自己打结。进去十个人，回来一个。回来的那一个，也不肯说里面有什么。

你爷爷，就是没回来的那九个之一。

你们站在断碑前面。

碑后面的松林黑沉沉的。没有风。没有鸟叫。静得像有人把整座山的声音，都装进口袋里拿走了。

**爹**：你在这儿等我。
story.en:
The children of Shi'ao hear the stories of Black Pine Ridge before they can walk.

At the mouth of the ridge stands a broken stele, half buried in the earth. Wind and rain have worked at its writing for who knows how many years; most of it can't be read. Only the last two characters are still perfectly clear —

**Do not enter.**

The old people of the village say that stele is older than the village, older than the Mas, older than the walls of the county town.

The old people of the village say that past the stele, the woods are different. The trees move by themselves; the paths tie themselves in knots. Ten go in, one comes back. And the one who comes back won't say what's inside.

Your grandfather was one of the nine who didn't.

The two of you stand before the broken stele.

The pines behind it are dark and heavy. No wind. No birdsong. So quiet it's as if someone had put every sound on the mountain into a sack and carried it off.

**Father:** Wait for me here.

label.en: Look at the back of the stele

exits.means: looks at the back of the stele, as Granny Wu said; compares the token

story.zh:
你想起吴婆婆的话，绕到碑后面，扒开半人高的枯草——

碑的背面，也刻着字。比正面的更深，更小，弯弯曲曲的，你一个都不认得。

只认得最底下，刻着一只小小的狐狸。蜷着。尾巴绕着身子。

你把怀里的木牌掏出来，比了一比。

一模一样。

你的心里，咯噔一下。

你看了看木牌。又看了看碑。又看了看木牌。

然后，你做了一个非常成熟的决定——

你把木牌收好了。什么都没说。

有些事，说出来，你爹今天就不会进去了。你爹不进去，马三就要来收弓。马三来收弓，你娘就又要蹲在地上捡东西。

这笔账，你算得很清楚。
story.en:
You remember what Granny Wu said, go round behind the stele, and part the dry grass, half as tall as a man —

The back of the stele is carved too. Deeper than the front, smaller, all curls and twists. You can't read a single character.

Except, at the very bottom, a tiny carved fox. Curled up. Tail wrapped around its body.

You take the token out of your jacket and hold it up beside it.

Identical.

Something in your chest goes *thunk*.

You look at the token. Then at the stele. Then at the token.

And then you make a very mature decision —

You put the token away. And say nothing.

Some things, said out loud, would mean your father doesn't go in today. If your father doesn't go in, Ma San comes for the bow. If Ma San comes for the bow, your mother ends up crouched on the floor picking things up again.

You've done that sum, and you're quite clear on it.

label.en: Make three rules, and go in with him

exits.means: goes in with father on conditions, sets rules, marks, turns back by sundown, runs if anything is wrong

story.zh:
你没有说「我不」。你想了想，说：

**你**：爹。你的腿，追不上鹿。

你爹愣住了。

**你**：我跟你进去。（竖起三根手指）但咱们定三条规矩。

**你**：一，每走三十步，我在树上刻一道记号。

**你**：二，太阳一过那道山梁，不管追没追到，掉头就走。

**你**：三——（你看着他的眼睛）只要有一样东西不对劲，不管是什么，不商量。跑。

你爹看着你，看了很久很久。他的眼睛有点红。你不知道是风吹的，还是别的什么。

**爹**：好。听你的。

**爹**：（顿了顿）……你娘教的？

**你**：嗯。

你爹长长地叹了一口气。那口气里，有一半是放心，还有一半，是有点吃醋。

**爹**：随她。随她好。

你们跨过了断碑。

跨过去的那一刻，你的耳朵里，轻轻地「嗡」了一下，像有人在很远很远的地方，敲了一记钟。

你回头看。断碑还在。

你往前走了几步。再回头——

断碑，没了。

你面不改色地，在身边那棵树上，刻下了第一道记号。

手有点抖。刻歪了。

你又在旁边刻了一道。这一回，没歪。

你决定，第一道不算。
story.en:
You don't say "I won't." You think a moment, and say:

**You:** Father. Your leg can't catch a deer.

Your father stops short.

**You:** I'm coming in with you. (holding up three fingers) But we make three rules.

**You:** One: every thirty steps, I cut a mark on a tree.

**You:** Two: once the sun passes that ridge, deer or no deer, we turn round.

**You:** Three — (you look him in the eye) the moment anything is wrong, anything at all, no talking it over. We run.

Your father looks at you for a long, long time. His eyes are a little red. You can't tell if it's the wind or something else.

**Father:** All right. We'll do it your way.

**Father:** (after a pause) …Your mother taught you that?

**You:** Mm.

Your father lets out a long sigh. Half of it is relief. The other half is a little bit jealous.

**Father:** Takes after her. Good. Take after her.

You step past the broken stele.

The moment you cross it, something hums softly in your ears — like a bell struck somewhere very, very far away.

You look back. The stele is still there.

You walk a few steps on. You look back again —

The stele is gone.

Without a flicker on your face, you cut the first mark into the tree beside you.

Your hand shakes a little. It comes out crooked.

You cut another beside it. This one's straight.

You decide the first one doesn't count.

exits.means: wants to go back to the village, gives up the hunt

story.zh:
**你**：爹，咱回吧。

你爹没回头。

**爹**：回去，弓就没了。

**爹**：（顿了顿）没了弓，冬天拿什么打肉？拿我的膝盖？

你看了看他缠着麻布的膝盖。它今天一句话都没说。你也没再说话。
story.en:
**You:** Father, let's go home.

Your father doesn't turn round.

**Father:** Go home, and the bow's gone.

**Father:** (after a pause) No bow, and what do we hunt with come winter? My knee?

You look at the hemp cloth wound round his knee. It hasn't said a word all day. Neither do you, now.

label.en: Leave Father here and go in alone

exits.means: wants to go in alone, leaving father behind

story.zh:
**你**：你在这儿等我。我一个人进去。

你爹一把攥住你的胳膊，攥得你生疼。

**爹**：你爷爷，就是一个人进去的。

他没再往下说。你也没再提。
story.en:
**You:** You wait here. I'll go in alone.

Your father grabs your arm so hard it hurts.

**Father:** Your grandfather went in alone.

He says nothing more. Neither do you.
